title: Withdrawing Unused Deposited Credit from a Harborline Account
content:
# Withdrawals of unused deposited credit

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

## Rule

A withdrawal may be made only while the account status is active. A withdrawal returns unused deposited credit from one deposit to that deposit's original payment method, and each deposit may be withdrawn against only once; a deposit whose credit history already shows a withdrawal entry or a charge-back entry against it is not withdrawn against again. A deposit may be withdrawn only on or before the entry date of the deposit being withdrawn plus the tier's withdrawal window in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the deposit date, counting the day after the deposit as day 1, and the last day is included. The amount withdrawn is the deposit's withdrawable amount, and a withdrawal below the tier's withdrawal minimum is not made. Credit that came from refunds, service credits or goodwill is never withdrawable, and bank transfer deposits are returned by bank transfer. The funds reach the payment method within the tier's processing time in business days, counted Monday to Friday excluding US federal holidays.

## Withdrawable amount of one deposit

1. Take the unspent non-cash credit: the sum of the refund, service credit and goodwill entries less the sum of the purchase entries, floored at zero.
2. The remaining deposited credit is the credit balance less that unspent non-cash credit.
3. Allocate the remaining deposited credit to the deposits newest first; each deposit's share is capped at that deposit's amount less any withdrawal already made against it.
4. A deposit older than the withdrawal window has a withdrawable amount of zero.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Withdrawal window (calendar days after the deposit) | Processing time (business days) | Withdrawal minimum | Refund credit withdrawable | Goodwill credit withdrawable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | 180 | 5 | $5.00 | No (false) | No (false) |
| Harborline Business Account | 180 | 5 | $5.00 | No (false) | No (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | 180 | 5 | $5.00 | No (false) | No (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | 180 | 3 | $5.00 | No (false) | No (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | 180 | 3 | $5.00 | No (false) | No (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | 180 | 2 | $5.00 | No (false) | No (false) |

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

A deposit is dated 3 February of a non-leap year. Day 1 is 4 February; day 180 is 2 August. A withdrawal on 2 August is inside the window; on 3 August it is outside.

## Worked allocation (hypothetical figures)

The ledger shows deposits of $250.00 (220 days old), $600.00 (100 days old) and $300.00 (40 days old), a refund entry of $30.00, a goodwill entry of $13.00 and purchase entries totalling $379.60; the balance is $813.40.

- Unspent non-cash credit: $43.00 less $379.60 is negative, floored at $0.00.
- Remaining deposited credit: $813.40.
- Newest first: the $300.00 deposit takes $300.00; the $600.00 deposit takes the remaining $513.40; the $250.00 deposit takes nothing and is in any case outside the window.
- The withdrawable amount of the $600.00 deposit is therefore $513.40.
